quotes.verbatim_quote:
Everything contained in both books can be approached in a number of ways:

1. melodies

2. arpeggios

3. counterpoint (2 simultaneous voices)
4. 3-part chords

5. 4-part chords
quotes.why_load_bearing: Core taxonomy of five ways to deploy any material in the system.

quotes.verbatim_quote:

quotes.why_load_bearing: Specific technique rule for arpeggio direction alternation across chords.
